description:
FILED s451y (Opus, round 10 agent Y) as the KNOWN, DELIBERATE residue of #620
(`my @a = (1,2) if COND`, fixed the same session).  It is the ONE combination
that fix does not cover, and it keeps DROPPING loudly (the #339 announcement +
a run-time die since the flip) rather than answering wrongly.

REPRO (perl vs ./runpcl):
    our @o = (1,2); { my @o = (@o, 3) if 1; print "[@o]\n"; }
        perl: [1 2 3]     PCL: statement DROPPED
    our @o = (1,2); { my @o = (@o, 3) if 0; print "[@o]\n"; }
        perl: []          PCL: statement DROPPED

WHY IT IS NOT COVERED.  `Pl::Parser2::_lower_block`'s container arm has two
SELF-REFERENTIAL shapes (`my @a = (@a, 1)`, `my ($x,@a) = ($a[0],@a)`), and
both work by FUSING the RHS into the `let` BINDING position, where CL's
parallel `let` still resolves the name to the OUTER scope -- that is the only
way the RHS can read the outer variable, since the new lexical shadows it
inside the body.  With a modifier, one `let` would need TWO binding values:
the copy when the condition holds and a FRESH EMPTY container when it does not
(probed: a false condition leaves the container declared and empty).

WHAT IT WOULD TAKE: bind the CONDITION to a temporary in an enclosing `let`
(it must be evaluated exactly once -- it can have side effects), then test that
temporary twice: once to choose each self-referenced name's binding init, once
around the assignment.  Roughly

    (let ((|$cond__mod__N| <COND>))
      (let ((@a (p-if |$cond__mod__N| (p-copy-array @a) (make-array 0 …))))
        (p-if |$cond__mod__N| <the assignment>)
        …))

MEASURED: the shape occurs in NO population -- emission A/B over lib/ + perl's
own t/ + the cpan-tests board (1007 files) and corpus-diff over perl-tests
(111) are byte-identical across the #620 fix, and the fix DELIBERATELY puts the
modifier back on the token run when the RHS is self-referential, so this shape
behaves exactly as it did before.  See the comment at that guard in
`Pl/Parser2.pm` (search "the one combination the two self-ref shapes below
cannot express").

BAR IF TAKEN: the two rows above vs perl; the LIST spelling `my ($x,@a) =
($a[0],@a) if COND` in both truth values; the condition evaluated EXACTLY ONCE
(a counter sub); the unconditional self-ref shapes byte-identical
(corpus-diff); guard rows beside the #620 family in Pl/t/stmt-modifier-01.t.


RULED s451 (Fable, Y ask 3): the sketched shape is RATIFIED -- evaluate the CONDITION exactly once, bound to a gensym temp, BEFORE the RHS (perl probes first: a false condition must leave the RHS unevaluated, so the order is cond -> maybe-RHS); the RHS evaluates in the OUTER scope (the let BINDING position, as the existing self-ref shapes do), and the new binding is (if tmp rhs-val fresh-container).  The shape occurs in NO population, so per the s371 rule probes + guard rows ARE the bar -- do not widen.  UNSCHEDULED filler (it drops loudly today); take it only as a same-mechanism ride-along of a Parser2 my-decl round.
